Q1: Not sure. The pictures never show flags, uniforms or any text that names who holds the Rock. They only show a fortified town below a big rock, with ships around it and in the bay.
Q2: A siege. Frame 23 has the caption '1779 — The Great Siege' and the date 20 Jun 1779. After that, the dates run on through 1779 and 1780 while ships gather around the Rock.
Q3: Not sure. Ships sit offshore and the town is surrounded, which suggests a blockade that cuts off supplies. The pictures show no food, no starving people and no explanation, so I'm inferring this from the siege caption and the ships.
Q4: Ships, apparently a fleet. Ship groups arrive in the bay around frames 47–50 (17 Jan to 4 Feb 1780). The pictures don't show them unloading anything or clearly relieving the town, so I'm not certain they are a rescue force.
